verdict.rationale: Word-level timestamps are a fair question for a speech-to-text API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents per-word timing in Gladia's transcription output. The closest items are SRT/VTT subtitle export and live utterance segmentation, which are caption- or segment-level features, not word-level timestamps, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording
